description: This file defines the HyperGeometric class which calculates the hypergeometric distribution probability, including validation and handling of array inputs, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: HyperGeometric
classes.description: Provides methods to compute the hypergeometric distribution probability, supporting array inputs and validation.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the hypergeometric distribution probability for given sample successes, sample size, population successes, and population size, with validation and array support.
